courses.summary: 達莉亞屬安哥拉 Block 17 的浮式生產群；本課比較產品黏性、熱量與船上處理庫存的教學情境。本課依序分析較黏物流的熱量帳、船上液體分離庫存、液相摩擦敏感度、卸油節奏緩衝、不同物流品質對帳，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Dalia belongs to Angola’s Block 17 FPSO group; teaching scenarios compare viscosity-related logistics, heat and onboard inventory. The course analyses thermal account for a more viscous stream, onboard liquid-separation inventory, liquid-friction sensitivity, buffer for offloading cadence, reconciliation of stream qualities, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
